$comment: Operational record of every model artifact this deployment can use.
Weights are NEVER committed to this repository -- see third_party/MANIFEST.md rule 5.
Every sha256 below was computed from the real downloaded artifact, not copied
from an upstream README. Verify on every fetch; a mismatch is fatal.
Artifacts marked optional:true are not fetched by default. Read their licence
block before you fetch one: not every model here is usable on every project.

models.name: melodyt5
models.role: Global score-to-score melody variation. Runs for both Refined and Developed.

license.$comment: Verified independently of the code licence, per third_party/MANIFEST.md. The HF model card declares license: mit.

notes: ~1.36 GB. Not baked into the container image unless benchmarking shows immutable bundling is operationally better.
Upstream's published environment is an old Python/PyTorch line. Which runtime this actually runs on is decided by the compatibility spike, not assumed. See docs/architecture/musician-runtime-adr.md.

models.name: midi-rwkv
models.role: Selective symbolic infill of nominated spans, conditioned on both sides. Runs for both Refined and Developed.

license.$comment: The weight is committed inside the MIT-licensed repository at the pinned revision, so it carries that licence.

notes: Inference runtime is upstream RWKV/rwkv.cpp, NOT the personal fork MIDI-RWKV pins. See third_party/MANIFEST.md.
MIDIMetrics is excluded: no detected licence, and it is an evaluation dependency the pipeline does not need.

models.name: game
models.role: Authoritative initial melodic-audio transcriber for canonical Raw material.

$comment: The two differ, so the artifact is fetched by the operator rather than redistributed.
The repository is MIT. The release notes for v1.0.0 state plainly: 'The model
files apply CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.' Non-commercial, attribution, share-alike.
Rhythmisoze itself is MIT, so these weights are NOT redistributable with it and
are never baked into an image. Fetching them is an operator's decision, and a
deployment that uses them is a non-commercial one.
Melodic audio reports unavailable when these required runtime weights are absent.

notes: ~47 MB zipped, ~51 MB unpacked. This small PyTorch model is the validated development backend.
GAME large v1.0.3 ONNX is the production target, but remains an explicit /ready blocker until its real graph runner and parity gate exist.
Audio is sent to this service; product and privacy copy disclose that before recording.
